title: Cross-cultural adaptation and psychometric properties of the Thai version of the modified COVID-19 Yorkshire Rehabilitation Scale in individuals with long COVID
core_idea: Translate and cross-culturally adapt the modified COVID-19 Yorkshire Rehabilitation Scale into Thai and assess its psychometric properties in individuals with long COVID using confirmatory and exploratory factor analysis, internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and construct validity comparisons with the Thai SF-36 and Thai FES-I.
tldr: Create a Thai version of the modified C19-YRSm and evaluate its measurement properties in people with long COVID via factor analysis and reliability/validity testing.
